title: Section 330.12 – Add new Sections 330.12(3) and 330.12(4) to read as follows:
officialText:
(3) Where used as service conductors.
(4) In any building exceeding 3 floors above grade, where the cable has an outer jacket of PVC, unless the PVC
jacketed cable is concealed within non-plenum walls, floors, or ceilings constructed with materials providing a listed
1-hour fire rated assembly.
